rejected.description: September 16, 2026 Upper Austria, Austria On September 16, a powerful storm system moving in from Bavaria swept across Upper Austria from west to east. Heavy rain, hail, and gale-force winds prompted approximately 250 emergency call-outs for fire crews across the region. The districts of Ried, Grieskirchen, and Eferding were the first to be affected. In Ried im Innkreis, gale-force winds toppled trees onto roads and houses, while downpours caused street and building flooding in Gurten and Aurolzmünster. In Krenglbach (Wels-Land district), a large tree fell onto a residential house, damaging the roof; a fire department crane was brought in to remove it. The storm later moved into central Upper Austria. Emergency calls increased in the Linz-Land, Kirchdorf, and Steyr-Land districts. In the Kematen an der Krems area, 11 reports—including instances of roof damage—were received within just a few minutes. Kremsmünster also saw fallen trees, damaged roofs, and damage to corn crops.
